category.name: Finance, payments and market data
category.description: Accept payments, move money, access bank data and query stock, FX and crypto prices.

entries.name: Adyen API
entries.free_tier: paid only; requires a signed merchant contract, pay per-transaction
entries.desc_en: Process payments, payouts, and manage disputes/balances across global payment methods via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires an approved Adyen merchant account before API keys are issued; no self-serve free signup like Stripe.

entries.name: Alpaca Trading API
entries.free_tier: free paper trading (unlimited); free basic (IEX) market data feed
entries.desc_en: Place stock/options/crypto trades and stream market data via REST/WebSocket API, with free paper trading.
entries.notes: Commission-free live trading requires a funded brokerage account (US persons/entities eligibility rules apply).

entries.name: Alpha Vantage
entries.desc_en: Fetch stock, forex, crypto prices and technical/fundamental indicators via a free REST API.
entries.notes: Free tier is limited to 25 requests/day; paid Premium plans needed for real-time/higher volume.

entries.name: Coinbase (CDP / x402)
entries.auth_hint: CDP API Key ID/Secret, JWT-signed bearer requests
entries.free_tier: free CDP API access (usage-based fees on some onchain services); x402 is pay-per-request, not a subscription
entries.desc_en: Create wallets, send crypto, and pay per-API-call with stablecoins over HTTP (x402) via the Coinbase Developer Platform SDK.
entries.notes: x402 is an open HTTP-402 payment protocol Coinbase champions, not a single vendor API - useful for agent-to-agent micropayments. No official MCP server confirmed.

entries.name: CoinGecko API
entries.auth_hint: x-cg-demo-api-key or x-cg-pro-api-key header; keyless via the free MCP endpoint
entries.free_tier: free Demo API plan (~10k calls/month, 30 calls/min); keyless free MCP with shared rate limits
entries.desc_en: Fetch live and historical crypto prices, market data, and NFT data via REST API or the official CoinGecko MCP server.
entries.notes: Free MCP endpoint (mcp.api.coingecko.com) requires no key at all, just shared rate limits; a Pro-key MCP endpoint also exists.

entries.name: Financial Modeling Prep
entries.desc_en: Fetch company financials, stock prices, and fundamental data via a REST API.
entries.notes: Many endpoints (full financial statements, etc.) require a paid plan.

entries.name: Open Exchange Rates
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 requests/month, USD base only, hourly updates
entries.desc_en: Fetch current and historical foreign-exchange rates for 200+ currencies via a REST API.
entries.notes: Free plan is restricted to USD as the base currency; multi-base conversion requires a paid plan.

entries.name: PayPal API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2 client-credentials Bearer token; MCP also supports an access-token env var
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only; sandbox for testing
entries.desc_en: Process payments, payouts, invoices, and subscriptions via REST API or PayPal's official MCP server.
entries.notes: Separate sandbox MCP endpoint at https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com for testing.

entries.name: Plaid API
entries.free_tier: free Sandbox/Development access; Production requires approval and has per-item pricing
entries.desc_en: Link bank accounts and fetch balances, transactions, and identity data via REST API/SDKs.
entries.notes: Sandbox is free and unlimited for development; moving to Production requires a Plaid approval/compliance review.

entries.name: Polygon.io / Massive
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> or apiKey query param
entries.free_tier: free tier available (delayed data, limited calls/min); paid plans for real-time
entries.desc_en: Query real-time and historical stocks, options, forex, and crypto market data via REST/WebSocket API.
entries.notes: Polygon.io rebranded to 'Massive' in 2026; the old polygon.io domain now redirects there. Massive also offers an MCP server for AI tools.

entries.name: Square API
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction processing fees; free Sandbox for testing
entries.desc_en: Process in-person/online payments, manage orders, invoices, and catalog via REST API and SDKs.
entries.notes: Requires a Square merchant account; Sandbox environment is free for development/testing. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable payments API.

entries.name: Stripe API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <secret_key> (or OAuth/Agent key for MCP)
entries.free_tier: free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only, no monthly fee
entries.desc_en: Create payments, subscriptions, invoices, and refunds programmatically via REST API or the official Stripe MCP server.
entries.notes: From Oct 31, 2026, Stripe MCP requires an 'Agent' API key or OAuth - full-access/restricted keys without the Agent tag stop working.

entries.name: Wise API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API token> (personal) or OAuth2 (Wise Platform partners)
entries.free_tier: free API access; normal Wise transfer fees apply per transaction; sandbox available
entries.desc_en: Send international transfers, check exchange rates, and manage multi-currency balances via REST API.
entries.notes: Full Wise Platform (send-money-as-a-partner) access requires a partnership agreement; a personal token covers your own account only.
